answer: The strongest lever is simple: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because sonnet only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. In practice gale is enforced by the ledger itself: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any horizon approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
